phase1.evidence: iNES header: magic NES<1A>, 16x16 KiB PRG, 16x8 KiB CHR, flags 0x40 (mapper 4, horizontal mirroring); parsed by inspect, not CPU-visible.
phase1.label: INesHeader

regions.summary: INesHeader: Generic data, 16 bytes (phase 1: static evidence). No direct consumer found by absolute-operand or pointer-immediate search, so it is probably reached through a pointer stored in other data. Format and meaning not decoded.

phase1.evidence: 16 KiB unit id byte: read by far-call routine (lda $8000 at $C868) to restore caller bank, and unit 30 id checked by reset (lda $C000 / cmp #$1E at $FDC0).
phase1.label: Unit00_BankId

regions.summary: Unit00_BankId: Unit id byte = 0 (the bank number). FarCall reads it at $8000 to remember which unit to restore; Reset checks the fixed bank's copy.

phase1.evidence: 2 little-endian words at $8001 indexed by far-call routine FarCall ($C88C: ldx $3A; lda $8001,x/$8002,x; jmp ($3A) at $C8D2). Table closed: it ends exactly at the lowest entry target. 2 entries used as code roots (exact far-call sites lda #idx/sta $3A/lda #unit/sta $3B/jsr $C862, observed execution, or closed table).
phase1.label: Unit00_EntryTable

regions.summary: Unit00_EntryTable: FarCall entry table: word k is the address of entry k (FarCallIndex = 2*k). Only words proven by far-call sites, observed execution or a closed table are code roots.

regions.summary: Code (Observed), unit 0 (banks 0/1 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above): U00_FieldLoadGraphics, U00_FieldStreamScroll, U00_FieldSelectMetatileSet, U00_FieldMapPtrFromScroll, U00_FieldRowEdgePtr

units.name: U00_FieldLoadGraphics
units.summary: Loads the field palette (LoadPalette) and the main and split CHR bank sets (Stub_LoadChrBanksMain/Split) from this unit's tables.

units.name: U00_FieldStreamScroll
units.summary: Per-NMI background streaming for the scrolling field. Recomputes the map pointer for the camera, then: when moving horizontally (ScrollVelX != 0) queues the newly exposed tile column; when moving vertically (ScrollVelY != 0) queues the new tile row; then the matching attribute column/row (attribute rows only every 8th frame unless moving vertically).

units.name: U00_FieldSelectMetatileSet
units.summary: Chooses the metatile definition table: rows past a fixed map address use the second table (map pointer >= $9C85).

units.name: U00_FieldMapPtrFromScroll
units.summary: Map pointer for the top-left visible metatile: base + (ScrollY/16)*128 + ScrollX/16.

units.name: U00_FieldRowEdgePtr
units.summary: Map pointer of the row being exposed: bottom edge (+15 rows) when scrolling down, top edge otherwise.

phase1.evidence: 16 KiB unit id byte: read by far-call routine (lda $8000 at $C868) to restore caller bank, and unit 30 id checked by reset (lda $C000 / cmp #$1E at $FDC0).
phase1.label: Unit02_BankId

regions.summary: Unit02_BankId: Unit id byte = 2 (the bank number). FarCall reads it at $8000 to remember which unit to restore; Reset checks the fixed bank's copy.

phase1.evidence: 2 little-endian words at $8001 indexed by far-call routine FarCall ($C88C: ldx $3A; lda $8001,x/$8002,x; jmp ($3A) at $C8D2). Table closed: it ends exactly at the lowest entry target. 2 entries used as code roots (exact far-call sites lda #idx/sta $3A/lda #unit/sta $3B/jsr $C862, observed execution, or closed table).
phase1.label: Unit02_EntryTable

regions.summary: Unit02_EntryTable: FarCall entry table: word k is the address of entry k (FarCallIndex = 2*k). Only words proven by far-call sites, observed execution or a closed table are code roots.

phase1.evidence: 894 instructions reached by bank-aware static control flow (branches/jsr/jmp/fallthrough) from validated vectors, unit entry tables at $8001, closed inline jump tables or observed code, in fixed 16 KiB unit context [2, 3, 30, 31]; all PRG switching is confined to fixed-bank far-call code, so unit code always runs with banks (u,u+1). Not observed executing (reachability unproven).

regions.summary: Code (Static), unit 2 (banks 2/3 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above): U02_FieldLoadGraphics, U02_FieldStreamScroll, U02_FieldSelectMetatileSet, U02_FieldMapPtrFromScroll, U02_FieldRowEdgePtr, U02_FieldRowVramAddr, U02_FieldQueueTileRow, U02_FieldNametableForX, U02_FieldFetchTilePair, U02_FieldMetatileDefAddr, U02_FieldColumnEdgePtr, U02_FieldColumnVramAddr, U02_FieldC

units.name: U02_FieldLoadGraphics
units.summary: Loads the field palette (LoadPalette) and the main and split CHR bank sets (Stub_LoadChrBanksMain/Split) from this unit's tables.

units.name: U02_FieldStreamScroll
units.summary: Per-NMI background streaming for the scrolling field. Recomputes the map pointer for the camera, then: when moving horizontally (ScrollVelX != 0) queues the newly exposed tile column; when moving vertically (ScrollVelY != 0) queues the new tile row; then the matching attribute column/row (attribute rows only every 8th frame unless moving vertically).

units.name: U02_FieldSelectMetatileSet
units.summary: Chooses the metatile definition table: rows past a fixed map address use the second table (map pointer >= $9C85).

units.name: U02_FieldMapPtrFromScroll
units.summary: Map pointer for the top-left visible metatile: base + (ScrollY/16)*128 + ScrollX/16.

units.name: U02_FieldRowEdgePtr
units.summary: Map pointer of the row being exposed: bottom edge (+15 rows) when scrolling down, top edge otherwise.

units.name: U02_FieldRowVramAddr
units.summary: Nametable address of the exposed tile row (nametable from ScrollX bit 8, row from ScrollYPpu).

units.name: U02_FieldQueueTileRow
units.summary: Queues the exposed row of tiles as two horizontal VramBuffer records (the part up to the right edge of this nametable and the remainder in the other one).

units.name: U02_FieldNametableForX
units.summary: Tmp00/01 = $2000 or $2400 depending on ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U02_FieldFetchTilePair
units.summary: Fetches the two tiles of the current metatile for this row half (Tmp04/Tmp05).

units.name: U02_FieldMetatileDefAddr
units.summary: Adds the metatile definition table base (chosen like FieldSelectMetatileSet) to Tmp02/03.

units.name: U02_FieldColumnEdgePtr
units.summary: Map pointer of the column being exposed: right edge (+16 metatiles) when scrolling right, left edge otherwise.

units.name: U02_FieldColumnVramAddr
units.summary: Nametable address of the exposed tile column.

units.name: U02_FieldColumnNametable
units.summary: Selects the nametable that receives the exposed column from the scroll direction and ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U02_FieldQueueTileColumn
units.summary: Queues the exposed tile column as vertical (+32) VramBuffer runs, split at the bottom of the nametable.

units.name: U02_FieldFetchColumnPair
units.summary: Fetches the two vertically stacked tiles of the current metatile for the column (Tmp04/Tmp05).

units.name: U02_FieldFetchColumnTile
units.summary: Fetches the lower tile of the current metatile when the column starts mid-metatile.

units.name: U02_FieldAttrPtrFromScroll
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer for the camera: base + (ScrollYPpu/32)*64 + ScrollX/32.

units.name: U02_FieldAttrRowPtr
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer of the row being exposed (bottom or top edge).

units.name: U02_FieldAttrRowVramAddr
units.summary: Attribute-table address of the exposed attribute row.

units.name: U02_FieldAttrTableBase
units.summary: Tmp00/01 = $23C0 or $27C0 from ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U02_FieldQueueAttrRow
units.summary: Queues the exposed attribute row (two horizontal runs, split at the nametable edge).

units.name: U02_FieldFetchAttrByte
units.summary: Fetches an attribute byte; near the 240-line seam it merges the nibbles of two map rows because the attribute grid does not line up with the 16-pixel map rows there.

units.name: U02_FieldAttrColumnPtr
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer of the column being exposed (right or left edge).

units.name: U02_FieldAttrColumnVramAddr
units.summary: Attribute-table address of the exposed attribute column.

units.name: U02_FieldAttrColumnTable
units.summary: Selects $23C0/$27C0 for the exposed attribute column.

units.name: U02_FieldQueueAttrColumn
units.summary: Queues the exposed attribute column with the VramBuffer attribute-column format ($C0 control), split at the bottom of the attribute table.

regions.summary: Code (Observed), unit 4 (banks 4/5 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above): U04_FieldLoadGraphics, U04_FieldStreamScroll, U04_FieldSelectMetatileSet, U04_FieldMapPtrFromScroll, U04_FieldRowEdgePtr, U04_FieldRowVramAddr, U04_FieldQueueTileRow, U04_FieldNametableForX, U04_FieldFetchTilePair, U04_FieldMetatileDefAddr, U04_FieldColumnEdgePtr, U04_FieldColumnVramAddr, U04_FieldC

units.name: U04_FieldLoadGraphics
units.summary: Loads the field palette (LoadPalette) and the main and split CHR bank sets (Stub_LoadChrBanksMain/Split) from this unit's tables.

units.name: U04_FieldStreamScroll
units.summary: Per-NMI background streaming for the scrolling field. Recomputes the map pointer for the camera, then: when moving horizontally (ScrollVelX != 0) queues the newly exposed tile column; when moving vertically (ScrollVelY != 0) queues the new tile row; then the matching attribute column/row (attribute rows only every 8th frame unless moving vertically).

units.name: U04_FieldSelectMetatileSet
units.summary: Chooses the metatile definition table: rows past a fixed map address use the second table (map pointer >= $9C85).

units.name: U04_FieldMapPtrFromScroll
units.summary: Map pointer for the top-left visible metatile: base + (ScrollY/16)*128 + ScrollX/16.

units.name: U04_FieldRowEdgePtr
units.summary: Map pointer of the row being exposed: bottom edge (+15 rows) when scrolling down, top edge otherwise.

units.name: U04_FieldRowVramAddr
units.summary: Nametable address of the exposed tile row (nametable from ScrollX bit 8, row from ScrollYPpu).

units.name: U04_FieldQueueTileRow
units.summary: Queues the exposed row of tiles as two horizontal VramBuffer records (the part up to the right edge of this nametable and the remainder in the other one).

units.name: U04_FieldNametableForX
units.summary: Tmp00/01 = $2000 or $2400 depending on ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U04_FieldFetchTilePair
units.summary: Fetches the two tiles of the current metatile for this row half (Tmp04/Tmp05).

units.name: U04_FieldMetatileDefAddr
units.summary: Adds the metatile definition table base (chosen like FieldSelectMetatileSet) to Tmp02/03.

units.name: U04_FieldColumnEdgePtr
units.summary: Map pointer of the column being exposed: right edge (+16 metatiles) when scrolling right, left edge otherwise.

units.name: U04_FieldColumnVramAddr
units.summary: Nametable address of the exposed tile column.

units.name: U04_FieldColumnNametable
units.summary: Selects the nametable that receives the exposed column from the scroll direction and ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U04_FieldQueueTileColumn
units.summary: Queues the exposed tile column as vertical (+32) VramBuffer runs, split at the bottom of the nametable.

units.name: U04_FieldFetchColumnPair
units.summary: Fetches the two vertically stacked tiles of the current metatile for the column (Tmp04/Tmp05).

units.name: U04_FieldFetchColumnTile
units.summary: Fetches the lower tile of the current metatile when the column starts mid-metatile.

units.name: U04_FieldAttrPtrFromScroll
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer for the camera: base + (ScrollYPpu/32)*64 + ScrollX/32.

units.name: U04_FieldAttrRowPtr
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer of the row being exposed (bottom or top edge).

units.name: U04_FieldAttrRowVramAddr
units.summary: Attribute-table address of the exposed attribute row.

units.name: U04_FieldAttrTableBase
units.summary: Tmp00/01 = $23C0 or $27C0 from ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U04_FieldQueueAttrRow
units.summary: Queues the exposed attribute row (two horizontal runs, split at the nametable edge).

units.name: U04_FieldFetchAttrByte
units.summary: Fetches an attribute byte; near the 240-line seam it merges the nibbles of two map rows because the attribute grid does not line up with the 16-pixel map rows there.

units.name: U04_FieldAttrColumnPtr
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer of the column being exposed (right or left edge).

units.name: U04_FieldAttrColumnVramAddr
units.summary: Attribute-table address of the exposed attribute column.

units.name: U04_FieldAttrColumnTable
units.summary: Selects $23C0/$27C0 for the exposed attribute column.

units.name: U04_FieldQueueAttrColumn
units.summary: Queues the exposed attribute column with the VramBuffer attribute-column format ($C0 control), split at the bottom of the attribute table.

phase1.evidence: 16 KiB unit id byte: read by far-call routine (lda $8000 at $C868) to restore caller bank, and unit 30 id checked by reset (lda $C000 / cmp #$1E at $FDC0).
phase1.label: Unit06_BankId

regions.summary: Unit06_BankId: Unit id byte = 6 (the bank number). FarCall reads it at $8000 to remember which unit to restore; Reset checks the fixed bank's copy.

phase1.evidence: 2 little-endian words at $8001 indexed by far-call routine FarCall ($C88C: ldx $3A; lda $8001,x/$8002,x; jmp ($3A) at $C8D2). Table closed: it ends exactly at the lowest entry target. 2 entries used as code roots (exact far-call sites lda #idx/sta $3A/lda #unit/sta $3B/jsr $C862, observed execution, or closed table).
phase1.label: Unit06_EntryTable

regions.summary: Unit06_EntryTable: FarCall entry table: word k is the address of entry k (FarCallIndex = 2*k). Only words proven by far-call sites, observed execution or a closed table are code roots.

phase1.evidence: 894 instructions reached by bank-aware static control flow (branches/jsr/jmp/fallthrough) from validated vectors, unit entry tables at $8001, closed inline jump tables or observed code, in fixed 16 KiB unit context [6, 7, 30, 31]; all PRG switching is confined to fixed-bank far-call code, so unit code always runs with banks (u,u+1). Not observed executing (reachability unproven).

regions.summary: Code (Static), unit 6 (banks 6/7 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above): U06_FieldLoadGraphics, U06_FieldStreamScroll, U06_FieldSelectMetatileSet, U06_FieldMapPtrFromScroll, U06_FieldRowEdgePtr, U06_FieldRowVramAddr, U06_FieldQueueTileRow, U06_FieldNametableForX, U06_FieldFetchTilePair, U06_FieldMetatileDefAddr, U06_FieldColumnEdgePtr, U06_FieldColumnVramAddr, U06_FieldC

units.name: U06_FieldLoadGraphics
units.summary: Loads the field palette (LoadPalette) and the main and split CHR bank sets (Stub_LoadChrBanksMain/Split) from this unit's tables.

units.name: U06_FieldStreamScroll
units.summary: Per-NMI background streaming for the scrolling field. Recomputes the map pointer for the camera, then: when moving horizontally (ScrollVelX != 0) queues the newly exposed tile column; when moving vertically (ScrollVelY != 0) queues the new tile row; then the matching attribute column/row (attribute rows only every 8th frame unless moving vertically).

units.name: U06_FieldSelectMetatileSet
units.summary: Chooses the metatile definition table: rows past a fixed map address use the second table (map pointer >= $9C85).

units.name: U06_FieldMapPtrFromScroll
units.summary: Map pointer for the top-left visible metatile: base + (ScrollY/16)*128 + ScrollX/16.

units.name: U06_FieldRowEdgePtr
units.summary: Map pointer of the row being exposed: bottom edge (+15 rows) when scrolling down, top edge otherwise.

units.name: U06_FieldRowVramAddr
units.summary: Nametable address of the exposed tile row (nametable from ScrollX bit 8, row from ScrollYPpu).

units.name: U06_FieldQueueTileRow
units.summary: Queues the exposed row of tiles as two horizontal VramBuffer records (the part up to the right edge of this nametable and the remainder in the other one).

units.name: U06_FieldNametableForX
units.summary: Tmp00/01 = $2000 or $2400 depending on ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U06_FieldFetchTilePair
units.summary: Fetches the two tiles of the current metatile for this row half (Tmp04/Tmp05).

units.name: U06_FieldMetatileDefAddr
units.summary: Adds the metatile definition table base (chosen like FieldSelectMetatileSet) to Tmp02/03.

units.name: U06_FieldColumnEdgePtr
units.summary: Map pointer of the column being exposed: right edge (+16 metatiles) when scrolling right, left edge otherwise.

units.name: U06_FieldColumnVramAddr
units.summary: Nametable address of the exposed tile column.

units.name: U06_FieldColumnNametable
units.summary: Selects the nametable that receives the exposed column from the scroll direction and ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U06_FieldQueueTileColumn
units.summary: Queues the exposed tile column as vertical (+32) VramBuffer runs, split at the bottom of the nametable.

units.name: U06_FieldFetchColumnPair
units.summary: Fetches the two vertically stacked tiles of the current metatile for the column (Tmp04/Tmp05).

units.name: U06_FieldFetchColumnTile
units.summary: Fetches the lower tile of the current metatile when the column starts mid-metatile.

units.name: U06_FieldAttrPtrFromScroll
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer for the camera: base + (ScrollYPpu/32)*64 + ScrollX/32.

units.name: U06_FieldAttrRowPtr
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer of the row being exposed (bottom or top edge).

units.name: U06_FieldAttrRowVramAddr
units.summary: Attribute-table address of the exposed attribute row.

units.name: U06_FieldAttrTableBase
units.summary: Tmp00/01 = $23C0 or $27C0 from ScrollX bit 8.

units.name: U06_FieldQueueAttrRow
units.summary: Queues the exposed attribute row (two horizontal runs, split at the nametable edge).

units.name: U06_FieldFetchAttrByte
units.summary: Fetches an attribute byte; near the 240-line seam it merges the nibbles of two map rows because the attribute grid does not line up with the 16-pixel map rows there.

units.name: U06_FieldAttrColumnPtr
units.summary: Attribute-map pointer of the column being exposed (right or left edge).

units.name: U06_FieldAttrColumnVramAddr
units.summary: Attribute-table address of the exposed attribute column.

units.name: U06_FieldAttrColumnTable
units.summary: Selects $23C0/$27C0 for the exposed attribute column.

units.name: U06_FieldQueueAttrColumn
units.summary: Queues the exposed attribute column with the VramBuffer attribute-column format ($C0 control), split at the bottom of the attribute table.

regions.summary: Code (Observed), unit 8 (banks 8/9 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above): U08_SndInit, U08_SndStart, U08_SndStartTrack, U08_SndUpdate, U08_SndTrackBegin, U08_SndReadCommand, U08_SndCommandLoop

units.name: U08_SndInit
units.summary: Silences the APU (APU_STATUS = 0, SndChannelMask = 0) and marks all 8 track slots free ($FF).

units.name: U08_SndStart
units.summary: Starts sound SoundRequest: its 4-byte SoundHeaders entry lists up to 4 track ids ($FF ends the list); each is started with SndStartTrack.

units.name: U08_SndStartTrack
units.summary: Starts track id A from TrackDefs (4 bytes: slot offset, channel byte, script pointer). If the slot was busy, its channel is first released from SndChannelMask.

units.name: U08_SndUpdate
units.summary: Once per NMI: lets UpdateFlyBallWhistle claim the triangle, then for each of the 8 track slots runs its tempo countdown, envelope, vibrato and volume slides and reads the next script command when the note ends. Each slot marks its channel in SndChannelsUsed so lower-priority slots do not overwrite it.

units.name: U08_SndTrackBegin
units.summary: Initialises a track slot from its script header (tempo, volume/duty, sweep) and resets slides and counters.

units.name: U08_SndReadCommand
units.summary: Script interpreter: reads command bytes until a note is played. $FF ends the track, $FD sets the loop point, $Ex/$Dx volume slides, $Cx envelope, $Bx repeat counts, $A0-$AF control (duty, sweep, volume, vibrato, jump, tempo); bytes below $A0 are notes (SndPlayNote).

units.name: U08_SndCommandLoop
units.summary: Reads and executes the next script byte of the current slot (command dispatch by high nibble); every command handler jumps back here until a note or the end of the track.

regions.summary: Code (Observed), unit 8 (banks 8/9 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above): U08_SndReleaseChannel, U08_SndClaimChannel, U08_SndReadVolumeByte, U08_SndWriteVolumeClaimed, U08_SndWriteVolume, U08_SndEnvelope, U08_SndVolumeSlide, U08_SndVibrato

units.name: U08_SndReleaseChannel
units.summary: Clears the channel's bit in SndChannelMask and APU_STATUS (track ended).

units.name: U08_SndClaimChannel
units.summary: If the current channel has already been written this frame by a higher-priority slot, returns straight to the caller's caller (the write is skipped).

units.name: U08_SndReadVolumeByte
units.summary: Reads a volume/duty operand: for normal channels converts it to duty bits (carry clear); for flagged channels takes 7 bits (carry set).

units.name: U08_SndWriteVolumeClaimed
units.summary: SndWriteVolume after checking the channel claim.

units.name: U08_SndWriteVolume
units.summary: Writes the slot's duty/volume byte to the channel's first APU register (TRI_LINEAR for the triangle); with an envelope active, uses SndEnvelope instead.

units.name: U08_SndEnvelope
units.summary: Envelope step: scales the volume by the elapsed fraction of the note (4-bit division) and writes it through the envelope tables.

units.name: U08_SndVolumeSlide
units.summary: Applies the $Dx/$Ex volume slide: every N frames moves the volume one step up or down within 0-15.

units.name: U08_SndVibrato
units.summary: Adds a vibrato offset (SndVibratoTable indexed by depth and SndFrameCount) to the period low byte.

regions.summary: Code (Static), unit 16 (banks 16/17 at $8000-$BFFF; fixed 30/31 above): U16_PlayerCutsceneInit, U16_CutsceneSetup, U16_CutsceneLoadScene

units.name: U16_PlayerCutsceneInit
units.summary: Far entry 3 (GameMode 3 sub-mode 18 init): U16_CutsceneSetup, then the first U16_PlayerCutsceneStep.

units.name: U16_CutsceneSetup
units.summary: Loads the cut-scene (U16_CutsceneLoadScene), sets the IRQ split at $98, adjusts three palette entries for some scenes when MenuRow bit 5 is set, and colours the figures with the fielding team's colour pair (U16_TeamColors; scene 8 uses other entries).

units.name: U16_CutsceneLoadScene
units.summary: Scenes $0C-$0E are re-picked from LoopCounter (scene $0F kept); loads scene CutsceneId through unit 18 entry 0. Scenes below $0C (except 8) write the featured fielder's name (CutsceneFielder, table at $A108) at $228A and play sfx $13; scenes $0C+ write the 2x2 glyph for RunsThisGame & 7 at $22D4/$22F4 (home run with 1-4 runs).

phase1.evidence: Table/data block bounded by classified code/data on both sides; its first byte is the base operand of lda (abs,x) at CPU $9D08 (and 1 other refs). Generic data: element layout not established.

regions.summary: U16_TeamColors: Colour pair per team for the cut-scene figures; +24 2x2 glyphs for the home-run run count.

units.name: U26_InitRunnerPlay
units.summary: GameMode 1 init, sub-mode 1 (a runner moved during the at bat / pick-off, tentative): gives the ball to the catcher (BallState $30 at entry) or the pitcher with the matching camera, then marks runners in states $22/$23/$42/$43/$62/$63 as running (low nibble 4).

units.name: U26_InitPassedBall
units.summary: GameMode 1 init, sub-mode 2 (passed ball / wild pitch, tentative): camera $80; the ball starts rolling to the backstop on the side of its lateral position (U26_StartBackstopRollLeft/Right), with Var88 = 3 and ball flag bit 3.

units.name: U26_InitAwardBase
units.summary: GameMode 1 init, sub-mode 3 (walk / hit by pitch, tentative): camera $D0, common init, the pitcher holds the ball.

units.name: U26_InitDroppedThirdStrike
units.summary: GameMode 1 init, sub-mode 4 (after a third strike that got past the catcher): same as sub-mode 2.

units.name: U26_InitBallDead
units.summary: GameMode 1 init, sub-mode 5: camera $60, BallState 0, common init.

units.name: U26_InitRestoreFieldView
units.summary: GameMode 1 init, sub-mode 6: rebuilds the field view at the saved camera position ($042F-$0432; repaints the visible screen with the field streamer), reloads palettes, updates ball and fielders once and continues in sub-mode 0.

units.name: U26_GiveBallToPitcher
units.summary: Puts fielder record 0 (pitcher) in state $42 holding the ball (U26_TakeBallToFielder), clears the ball record and sets BallState $50 (ball held).

units.name: U26_GiveBallToCatcher
units.summary: Same as U26_GiveBallToPitcher for fielder record 1 (catcher).

units.name: U26_MarkRunnerRunning
units.summary: Runner record at ObjPtr in state $22/$23/$42/$43/$62/$63: changes its low nibble to 4 (tentative: running).

units.name: U26_StartBackstopRollLeft
units.summary: Starts the loose ball at the plate rolling backward and to one side (BallState $52, lateral speed $08, BallY $2100).

units.name: U26_StartBackstopRollRight
units.summary: As U26_StartBackstopRollLeft for the other side (lateral speed $F8, BallY $1F00); both reset the flight parameters (U26_ResetFlightParams).

regions.summary: Code (Observed), fixed banks 30/31 at $C000-$FFFF: PowerOnInit, ModeTransition, MainLoop

units.name: PowerOnInit
units.summary: Power-on initialisation after Reset: vertical mirroring, PPUCTRL shadow with sprites at $1000, NMI and rendering off, both nametables cleared, sound reset, GameMode 3 (front end) with sub-mode 0, Var65 = 4. Reads the controllers once; the A+B test that follows has no effect because both paths continue at ModeTransition (probably a removed debug hook).

units.name: ModeTransition
units.summary: Runs the init handler (unit entry 0) of the current GameMode with NMI and rendering disabled, repeating while the handler sets bit 7 again. Also sets IrqSplitEnable/ChrA12Invert to $80 before init (the handler may change them), recomputes ScrollYPpu, clears the VRAM buffer and pending palette upload, waits for vblank and re-enables rendering and NMI.

units.name: MainLoop
units.summary: Main loop, one pass per NMI frame. Fixed: (1) fixed_30_31.asm DmcSample_D5C0..F9C0 headers wrongly said generic/no consumer - now DPCM samples of DmcSampleTable with start/length/record numbers; Bank31Data_E000 renamed DmcSample_DAC0_Tail (tail of sample $DAC0-$E0C0). (2) U16 password: character letters 10=R, 11=D, 12=B, 14=C added (redirect r2-a); U16_PasswordText/InvalidText prose corrected (blank run / INVA... start), new U16_InvalidTextRest with TRY AGAIN, GO BACK TO START, ENTER PASSWORD and the menu cursor sprite sublabels.
